Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Both a construction worker and a professor agreed to help raise money for their local community center. Though the construction worker was really helpful in the organization and running of several different events and raised a ton of money in the end, the professor was more trouble than they were worth and ended up mixing up dates, forgetting when they needed to complete different tasks, and really just couldn't do anything helpful at all. Who is competent?
A. Can't answer
B. The construction worker
C. The professor
